intro: Between 2026-04-12 and 2026-09-29, ZCyberNews published 50 articles tagged data-breach. ShinyHunters, LockBit, and Cl0p were the top threat actors observed across this coverage. CVE-2026-35273 was the most frequently cited vulnerability. The affected sectors spanned government, healthcare, education, retail, and technology. North america, United states, Europe, Global, and France were the most affected regions. Of the 50 articles, 40 were rated high severity and 6 medium severity. This archive collects reporting on data-breach incidents across that period, tracking the actors, vulnerability, sectors, and regions documented in each case.
